source_refs.note: Book p. 173: 9.1.3 Synthetic Division, layout figure, Out Line of the Method (i)-(iii) with patterns, Example 7 table. Book errors: 'Vertical patter'; quotient x^2 + 0x + 9 for x^2 + 0x - 9. Teaching notes, Key points, Common mistakes are ours.

blocks.text: Long division theek hai, lekin lambi hai: har baar \(x\) ki powers likhna, signs badalna, subtract karna. Jab divisor \(x - a\) jaisa simple ho to ek bohat tez tareeqa hai: synthetic division. Is mein hum sirf numbers (coefficients) ke saath kaam karte hain, aur subtract ki jagah sirf jama karte hain. Is page par yeh tareeqa seekh kar kitab ki Example 7 mein ek polynomial ke chaar factors nikalenge.
Kitab kehti hai: polynomial \(f(x)\) ko \(x - a\) shakal ke polynomial se long division karne ka ek achha shortcut tareeqa hai. Is division ke tareeqe ko Synthetic Division kehte hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Synthetic division se bilkul wohi quotient aur remainder aata hai jo long division se aata hai. Farq sirf likhne ka hai: \(x\) ki powers nahin likhte, sirf coefficients likhte hain, aur divisor ka sign pehle hi badal kar \(a\) likh dete hain, is liye subtract ki jagah jama karna parta hai.
Shart yaad rakhein: yeh sirf \(x - a\) jaise divisor ke liye hai. \(x + 2\) ho to use \(x - (-2)\) likh kar \(a = -2\) lein. \(x^{2} - x + 1\) jaise divisor ke liye yeh tareeqa nahin chalta; wahan long division hi karni hai.

Polynomial \(px^{3} + qx^{2} + cx + d\) ko \(x - a\) se divide karne ka naqsha (layout) neeche figure mein hai. Teen lines hain: pehli line mein coefficients, doosri mein multiply kar ke aane wale numbers, aur teesri mein jama ka natija.

blocks.alt: Peele pas-manzar par synthetic division ka khaka. First line: a, gulabi khari lakeer, phir p, q, c, d. Second line: q, c, d ke neeche gulabi boxes, pehle mein ap. Gulabi pari lakeer ke neeche third line: p aur q, c, d ke neeche boxes. Neele teer har column mein neeche (jama) aur tirchhe agle column ki taraf (a se zarb). Daayein: first line, Second line, third line. Bracket quotient ke coefficients dikhata hai; teer aakhri box ko Remainder batata hai.

items: Dividend \(f(x)\) ke coefficients baayein se daayein, \(x\) ki ghatti hui powers ki tarteeb mein likhein. Jo term gayab ho us ki jagah 0 likhein.
Pehli line ke baayein taraf divisor \((x - a)\) ka \(a\) likhein.
Doosri aur teesri line likhne ke liye yeh patterns istemal karein:

blocks.text:
Vertical pattern (↓): terms ko jama karein
Diagonal pattern (↗): \(a\) se multiply karein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein "Vertical patter" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "Vertical pattern" hai. Sirf spelling ki ghalti hai, tareeqa wohi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ise ek rhythm ki tarah yaad karein: "neeche utaaro, zarb do, jama karo".
1. Pehla coefficient seedha neeche teesri line mein utaar dein.
2. Use \(a\) se multiply karein aur jawab doosri line mein agle column mein likhein (diagonal teer).
3. Us column ko jama karein (vertical teer) aur jawab teesri line mein likhein.
4. Aakhri column tak 2 aur 3 dohrate rahein.
Teesri line ka aakhri number remainder hai; us se pehle wale numbers quotient ke coefficients hain. Quotient ki degree dividend se ek kam hoti hai.
Kyun jama aur subtract nahin? Long division mein hum \(x - a\) ke \(-a\) se zarb dete aur phir subtract karte the. Do minus mil kar plus ban jate hain, is liye yahan seedha \(a\) se zarb de kar jama kar lete hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai: 9.1 ki Example 1 (\(3x^{3} - 10x^{2} + 13x - 6\) ÷ \(x - 2\)) ko synthetic division se dobara karte hain:
\[\begin{array}{r|rrrr} 2 & 3 & -10 & 13 & -6 \\ & & 6 & -8 & 10 \\ \hline & 3 & -4 & 5 & \boxed{4} \end{array}\]
3 neeche; \(3 \times 2 = 6\), \(-10 + 6 = -4\); \(-4 \times 2 = -8\), \(13 - 8 = 5\); \(5 \times 2 = 10\), \(-6 + 10 = 4\).
Quotient \(3x^{2} - 4x + 5\), remainder 4: bilkul wohi jo long division se aaya tha, aur kitna jaldi!

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text:
Synthetic division shuru karne se pehle teen cheezein zaroor check karein, kyun ke zyada tar ghaltiyan shuru hi mein hoti hain:
1. Divisor waqai \(x - a\) ki shakal ka hai? (\(x\) ka coefficient 1 aur power 1.)
2. \(a\) ka sign sahi hai? \(x - 5\) ke liye \(a = 5\), \(x + 5\) ke liye \(a = -5\).
3. Dividend ki koi power gayab to nahin? Har gayab power ke liye 0 likhna hai, warna coefficients ghalat columns mein aa jate hain.
Aur aakhri number ko ek chhoti si diwaar (bar) ya box se alag kar dein, taa ke remainder aur quotient ke coefficients aapas mein na milein.

Ab kitab ki Example 7. Is mein synthetic division do baar lagani hai: pehle ek factor se, phir jo quotient bache us ko doosre factor se. Yeh tareeqa bohat kaam ka hai: har baar degree ek kam hoti hai, aur jab quadratic bach jaye to use aasani se factorize kar sakte hain.

blocks.title: Example 7
blocks.problem: If \((x - 2)\) and \((x + 2)\) are factors of \(x^{4} - 13x^{2} + 36\). Using synthetic division, find the other two factors.
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x^{4} - 13x^{2} + 36\), jis ke factors \(x - 2\) aur \(x + 2\) hain.
To find: baqi do factors.
Method: degree 4 ka polynomial hai, to chaar linear factors ho sakte hain. Do diye hue hain. Plan: pehle \(x - 2\) se synthetic division, phir jo quotient aaye use \(x + 2\) se divide. Aakhir mein quadratic bachega jise factorize karna aasan hai.

Step 1: Saare coefficients likhein
\[f(x) = x^{4} + 0x^{3} - 13x^{2} + 0x + 36\]
Coefficients: \(1, 0, -13, 0, 36\).
\[x - a = x - 2 \Rightarrow a = 2\]
\[x - a = x + 2 = x - (-2) \Rightarrow a = -2\]
Kyun: \(x^{3}\) aur \(x\) wali terms gayab hain, un ki jagah 0 likhna zaroori hai, warna columns khisak jate hain aur poora jawab ghalat ho jata hai. Kitab \(-0x\) likhti hai; \(-0x\) aur \(+0x\) ek hi cheez hain.

Step 2: \(x - 2\) se divide (\(a = 2\))
\[\begin{array}{r|rrrrr} 2 & 1 & 0 & -13 & 0 & 36 \\ & & 2 & 4 & -18 & -36 \\ \hline & 1 & 2 & -9 & -18 & \boxed{0} \end{array}\]
1 neeche; \(1 \times 2 = 2\), \(0 + 2 = 2\); \(2 \times 2 = 4\), \(-13 + 4 = -9\); \(-9 \times 2 = -18\), \(0 - 18 = -18\); \(-18 \times 2 = -36\), \(36 - 36 = 0\).
Kyun: remainder 0 aaya, jo factor theorem ke mutabiq tasdeeq hai ke \(x - 2\) waqai factor hai. Quotient \(x^{3} + 2x^{2} - 9x - 18\) hai (degree 4 se ek kam, yani 3).

Step 3: Quotient ko \(x + 2\) se divide (\(a = -2\))
\[\begin{array}{r|rrrr} -2 & 1 & 2 & -9 & -18 \\ & & -2 & 0 & 18 \\ \hline & 1 & 0 & -9 & \boxed{0} \end{array}\]
1 neeche; \(1 \times (-2) = -2\), \(2 - 2 = 0\); \(0 \times (-2) = 0\), \(-9 + 0 = -9\); \(-9 \times (-2) = 18\), \(-18 + 18 = 0\).
Kyun: phir remainder 0, yani \(x + 2\) bhi factor hai. Naye quotient ke coefficients \(1, 0, -9\) hain. Dhyan dein: \(-9 \times (-2) = +18\), minus ke saath minus plus.

Step 4: Dono divisions ek table mein (kitab ki tarah)
\[\begin{array}{r|rrrrr} 2 & 1 & 0 & -13 & 0 & 36 \\ & & 2 & 4 & -18 & -36 \\ \hline -2 & 1 & 2 & -9 & -18 & \boxed{0} \\ & & -2 & 0 & 18 & \\ \hline & 1 & 0 & -9 & \boxed{0} & \end{array}\]
Kyun: kitab pehli division ki teesri line se hi doosri division shuru kar deti hai. Dono boxed zero remainders hain.

Step 5: Quotient likh kar factorize karein
Aakhri line \(1, 0, -9\) se quotient:
\[x^{2} + 0x - 9 = x^{2} - 9\]
\[= (x + 3)(x - 3)\]
Kyun: \(x^{2} - 9 = x^{2} - 3^{2}\), yeh difference of squares (do squares ka farq) hai: \(a^{2} - b^{2} = (a + b)(a - b)\).

Tasdeeq:
\[(x - 2)(x + 2)(x + 3)(x - 3)\]
\[= (x^{2} - 4)(x^{2} - 9)\]
\[= x^{4} - 13x^{2} + 36\]
Yahi \(f(x)\) hai. Chaaron factors sahi hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 7 mein kitab ne quotient \(x^{2} + 0x + 9\) chhapa hai, lekin table ki aakhri line \(1, 0, -9\) hai. Sahi quotient \(x^{2} + 0x - 9 = x^{2} - 9\) hai. Kitab ka agla hissa (\(x^{2} - 9 = (x + 3)(x - 3)\)) aur aakhri jawab sahi hain; sirf "+9" mein sign ki ghalti hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
1. \(x^{3} - 7x + 6\) ko synthetic division se \(x - 2\) par divide karte waqt pehli line kya likhenge? (Jawab: \(1, 0, -7, 6\); \(x^{2}\) ki jagah 0.)
2. Agar teesri line \(2, -1, 3 \mid 5\) aaye, to quotient aur remainder kya hain? (Jawab: quotient \(2x^{2} - x + 3\), remainder 5.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Synthetic division sirf \(x - a\) jaise divisor ke liye shortcut hai.
2. Saare coefficients ghatti hui powers mein likhein, gayab term ke liye 0; baayein taraf \(a\).
3. Vertical pattern: jama; diagonal pattern: \(a\) se zarb.
4. Aakhri number remainder; baqi quotient ke coefficients (degree ek kam).
5. Remainder 0 ho to \(x - a\) factor hai, aur quotient ko agle factor se phir divide kar sakte hain (Example 7).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Gayab power ke liye 0 na likhna (Example 7 mein \(0x^{3}\) aur \(0x\) dono).
2. Divisor \(x + 2\) ke liye \(a = 2\) le lena; sahi \(a = -2\) hai.
3. Long division ki aadat se columns mein subtract kar dena; synthetic division mein hamesha jama karte hain.
4. Quotient ki degree ghalat parhna: \(1, 0, -9\) ka matlab \(x^{2} + 0x - 9\) hai, \(x^{3}\) wala nahin.
